tests.name: Qualité du code
tests.setup: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bc
tests.run: quality_score=0; shebang_count=$(find Exos -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/test_*' -exec grep -l '^#!/bin/bash' {} \; | wc -l); total_scripts=$(find Exos -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/test_*' | wc -l); [ "$shebang_count" -eq "$total_scripts" ] && [ "$total_scripts" -gt 0 ] && quality_score=$(echo "$quality_score + 0.5" | bc); comment_count=$(find Exos -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/test_*' -exec grep -c '^#' {} \; | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}'); [ "$comment_count" -gt 15 ] && quality_score=$(echo "$quality_score + 0.5" | bc); exec_count=$(find Exos -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/test_*' -executable | wc -l); [ "$exec_count" -eq "$total_scripts" ] && [ "$total_scripts" -gt 0 ] && quality_score=$(echo "$quality_score + 0.5" | bc); error_handling=$(find Exos -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/test_*' -exec grep -l 'exit 1\|return 1' {} \; | wc -l); [ "$error_handling" -ge 2 ] && quality_score=$(echo "$quality_score + 0.5" | bc); echo "Score qualité : $quality_score / 2"
